_about: Prince's voice, objectively. 'accept' ranges come from Da Boss-approved versions (clip, gold rebuild, fresh munis-nannar, nanni, mama F) widened by a tolerance; the 'not' list from rejected versions and standard failures (analysis/negative_space.py). Small sample: refine as more approved material arrives.

pitch_change_st.why: frame-to-frame pitch steadiness; above = synthetic/child/chipmunk wobble, ~0 = robotic

jitter_pct.why: pitch roughness; above = synthetic, child-like, breathy

shimmer_dB.why: loudness roughness; above = synthetic/child, below = robotic/choppy

H1A3.why: the hum cliff; below = ordinary/synthetic/chipmunk, ABOVE = overdone hum, heard as a child

HNR_0_500.why: purity where the hum lives; below = breathy/ordinary, above = robotic

flux_p95.why: biggest frame-to-frame spectral jumps; above = choppy/chipmunk, below = slurred

flux.why: how much the sound keeps moving; below = frozen/robotic/choppy, above = breathy

voiced_pct.why: he hums through his phrases; below = ordinary/synthetic

VTL_cm.why: size from formant spacing; below = chipmunk, above = adult

F3_low.why: lowest F3 (5th pct); below = r-colour or rounding where there shouldn't be

H1H2.why: fundamental over 2nd harmonic (depends on sounds used)

loud_per_st.why: his loudness does not follow his pitch

not.ordinary adult: pitch wobble x5-8, jitter x3, shallow hum cliff (H1-A3 ~24-28), less voicing, impure low band
not.synthetic (TTS): pitch wobble x3-5, shallow hum cliff, jitter/shimmer high
not.a child: OVERDONE hum cliff (H1-A3 42-46), pitch wobble x2, short tract or low F3
not.chipmunk: pitch and resonances up together: wobble x10, tract < 11 cm, huge spectral jumps, shallow cliff
not.breathy: jitter up, low-band purity down (HNR<500 ~22), sound moving too much
not.robotic / frozen: pitch wobble ~0, purity too high (HNR<500 ~50), spectral movement too low, loudness tied to pitch
not.choppy: spectral movement too low inside sounds, shimmer too low
not.slurred: joins melt more than his (~2.6 dB spectral change at a join)
not.nana / rarra: phoneme identity, not voice quality: vowel edges carry the wrong consonant (n: F2 falling from ~2360; r: F3 dropping)
not.formulaic prosody: prosody, not voice quality: variation without a reason, pitch moving inside vowels, fades mid-utterance

ɑ.source: derived from ã (Da Boss: mama version F)

n.source: recorded; vowel after n: F2 falls into the vowel

m.source: recorded; vowel after m: F2 rises from low (lips lower F1/F2, never F3)

prosody.pitch_moves_in: consonants, never sliding inside a vowel
prosody.fade: only at the end of what he is saying: ~20 dB drop in 20 ms, then a humming tail 80-150 ms
prosody.variation: only with a reason (intent), never random

_tolerance_note: class ranges widened ~10% beyond his measured values (his own clip sat on the edges)
